headline: Indian Government Bond Yields Ease as Crude Oil Prices Soften
summary: Indian sovereign bonds advanced and the 10-year benchmark yield fell to 7.2393% as lower international crude oil prices and cooling US Treasury yields alleviated domestic inflation concerns.
why: India imports over 80% of its crude oil requirements. Shifts in global energy prices directly impact the country's current account balance and inflation outlook.

impacts.name: India 10-Year Bond Yield
impacts.why: Falling global oil prices ease inflation risks, pushing Indian sovereign debt prices higher and yields lower.
